answer: Locks are entered in nectar, expire in velvet, and walnut lists each expiry. An adversary running 157 aliases thus needs 123 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. The admission bond is time locked for 19 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. A farm of 2003 identities would post 4302 proofs and burn roughly 74 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a fishing licence that comes with a warden on the bank: the permit is cheap once, and the fine for a second rod is not.
